label: Tasks
description: Creates and manages asynchronous Tasks. This contract owns both the execution-side taskContext and the stable Task handles used for observation and control.

taskOptions.description: Options passed to tasks.run() to create and start Task execution.

title.description: Non-empty display title for the Task.

background.description: Whether the Task is globally visible and may continue independently of its initiating UI.

handler.description: Function invoked asynchronously with a taskContext. Its returned value becomes the result; throwing or rejecting fails the Task.

data.description: Optional arbitrary input exposed to the handler as taskContext.data.

taskContext.description: Execution-side context passed to tasks.run() handlers and injected into Commands as task. It is distinct from the public Task handle.

data.description: Optional arbitrary input supplied through taskOptions.data.

setDescription.description: Function setDescription(description) updating the live Task description while execution is running.

setProgress.description: Function setProgress(value, max = 100) reporting execution progress. Passing null makes progress indeterminate.

log.description: Function log(text) appending general execution output.

info.description: Function info(text) appending an informational execution message.

warn.description: Function warn(text) appending a non-fatal warning.

error.description: Function error(text) appending error-level output. It does not fail the Task; only throwing or rejecting from the handler changes lifecycle status to error.

taskOutput.description: One ordered execution-output entry. Its level is independent of Task lifecycle status.

timestamp.description: Date recording when the output entry was appended.

level.description: Execution-output severity; error does not imply that the Task failed.

taskOutputPage.description: Page of output entries returned by task.getOutput().

task.description: Stable live Task handle returned by tasks.run(), tasks.get() and tasks.list(). This is the observation/control side of execution, not taskContext.

background.description: Whether this Task is a background Task.

status.description: Lifecycle status. It becomes error only when the handler throws or rejects, not when taskContext.error() writes output.

progress.description: null before determinate progress is reported or when progress is indeterminate; otherwise an object with value and max.

error.description: Handler failure details when lifecycle status is error, otherwise null. Error-level output is not a failure.

createdAt.description: Cloned Date recording when the Task was registered.

startedAt.description: Cloned Date recording when execution started, or null.

endedAt.description: Cloned Date recording when execution ended, or null.

getOutput.description: Async method getOutput({cursor?, limit?}) returning a chronological taskOutputPage. The limit defaults to 100 and must be between 1 and 1000.

getResult.description: Async method getResult() returning the task's result. Waits for successful completion and rejects on error or cancellation. Results may be strings, objects, URLs or file references.

wait.description: Async method wait() resolving when the task reaches finished, error or canceled. Does not reject merely because the task failed.

cancel.description: Async method cancel() requesting cancellation. Resolves when the cancellation request has been processed.

addEventListener.description: EventTarget method registering a listener, including for change events emitted when this Task changes.

removeEventListener.description: Removes a previously registered task listener.

taskList.description: Snapshot array containing stable references to live Task handles.

items.description: Live Task object conforming to the task type.

xshell:tasks:added.description: Emitted on the application bus when a task is registered.

xshell:tasks:updated.description: Emitted on the application bus when a task's state, description, progress or output changes.

xshell:tasks:removed.description: Emitted on the application bus when a task is removed.

run.description: Creates and starts a Task. Executes options.handler(taskContext) asynchronously and immediately returns its live Task handle. A returned value becomes the result; throwing or rejecting marks the Task as failed.

returns.description: The newly created live Task object.

get.description: Returns the registered live Task object by ID, or undefined if not found.

returns.description: The live Task object, or undefined.

list.description: Returns a snapshot array containing references to all registered live Task objects.

clear.description: Removes finished, failed and canceled tasks from the registry. Running tasks are retained.

remove.description: Removes a terminal task from the registry without deleting any files or results produced by the task.
